items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: Alright Aris yeah you take the bell.

ctx.x: Oh, you don't have to. What about, lunch? What about that bell ringing? I wanted to ask you

about that. Oh, the bell? I just, I just ring the bell. Still, huh? Yeah. What church is, uh, keep the name of your church? Uh, my church is St. John Devine on Durbin Street, Durbin and N.H. And all the rest of your churches that come together? Uh, sometimes I be at, on on Turo and Clayborne. Sometimes I be on Vildred and, Vildred and, Vildred and Robinson. How you talking? How the sound go? Every time I hit, see, I can, I can stand, I can be, sometimes, I can tell if there's got anything coming. Because, I look…
Say, boy I don't see how you can make it. I say, you know why? It's the way you carry it.
